title: I Wish You'd Told Me
gist_ar: مشهد بين بنت وأبوها: هو بيعترف إنه خد منها حقها إنها تقرّر.

before_listening.en: A daughter and her father. He gives several reasons, but admits only one mistake. Listen for WHICH one he admits.
before_listening.ar: بنت وأبوها. هو بيدي أسباب كتير، بس بيعترف بغلطة واحدة. ركّز على أنهي غلطة اعترف بيها.

segments.speaker: Hana
segments.text: March. Since March, and you told Amir.

segments.speaker: Father
segments.text: I wish you wouldn't look at me like that. I didn't tell Amir. Amir works at the hospital. Amir found out, which is not the same thing.

segments.speaker: Hana
segments.text: If only you'd said something. One sentence. Hana, I've had some tests.

segments.speaker: Father
segments.text: And then what? You'd have come back from Dubai, you'd have lost the contract, and you'd have sat in this flat for six months watching me have tests. I wish I could tell you I'd have handled it better than you would have. I wouldn't.

segments.speaker: Hana
segments.text: That was my decision to make.

segments.speaker: Father
segments.text: Yes. It was. That's the part I got wrong. I keep wishing I'd been the sort of father you could have told bad news to. Then maybe I'd have been the sort you could hear it from.

segments.speaker: Father
segments.text: Don't. Not yet. Ask me the medical question. You've been holding it since you walked in.

segments.speaker: Hana
segments.text: What did they say on Thursday?

segments.speaker: Father
segments.text: They said it's operable. They said Tuesday. I wish it were sooner. And before you say it: yes, I have already told your mother, and no, I did not tell her first. She asked me the same question you did, in the same voice, standing in the same place. You are more like her than either of you would like.

gist_question.q: Which mistake does the father actually admit to?
options: Letting Amir find out about the diagnosis before Hana did
Taking away Hana's right to decide for herself
Waiting until Tuesday for the operation
The father told Amir about it directly, before he told Hana
He works at the hospital and found out

questions.q: What reason does the father give for not telling her?
questions.q_ar: إيه السبب اللي الأب قاله لعدم إخبارها؟
options: She would have lost the contract and sat watching him have tests
He simply forgot to mention it
The doctors advised him not to

questions.q: What does he ask Hana to do?
options: Leave and come back on Tuesday
Ask him the medical question she has been holding
